snippet.title: ClaimLand – Claim the real world, one plot at a time (Gameplay)
snippet.description:
ClaimLand turns the real map into a game board. Walk there, visit the plots around you, claim them and earn gold every minute. Other players can buy your land, so take it back. Build from tent to castle and rule your country's leaderboard.

Free to play on Google Play and in the browser: claimland.app

Music: "Happy Beats / Business Moves vol. 12" by ende.app (CC BY 4.0)
